fields.label: Wait
fields.description: From the request to its resolution or expiry. Null while it waits.

fields.label: Change requests
fields.description: Change requests this session attached to its task.

fields.label: Failed turns
fields.description: Turns that failed or were interrupted.

fields.label: Cost
fields.description: The sum of the turns with a known cost. Null when no turn has one.

fields.label: Most repeated calls in a turn
Most files rewritten in a turn
Tool
fields.description: The MCP tool's name, or the call's kind, such as execute or edit, for a built-in tool.

fields.label: Failed
fields.description: The call failed, or its command exited with a nonzero code.

fields.label: Event
fields.description: The sequence number of the call's first event.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: From the first update to the last, for a call that settled. Null when one end is unknown.

fields.label: First event
fields.description: The sequence number of the turn's first event in its session.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: What the schedule runs: core or plugin work, or a target such as node-action or workflow.

fields.label: Available
fields.description: False when nothing on this Node can run it, such as a disabled plugin.

fields.label: Next run
fields.description: Null when the schedule is off, unavailable, or every schedule is paused.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: Null for work the whole Node does.

fields.label: Uncommitted changes
fields.description: Null when the Node has not inspected the worktree.

fields.label: Folder
fields.description: The file's first two folders in its project, or . for the project folder itself.

fields.label: File type
fields.description: The file name extension without its dot, or empty when it has none.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The matched line, cut to 200 characters.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Whether the cycle is running now, still to come, or over. A cycle completed early is over.

fields.label: Progress
fields.description: Linear's progress, as a percentage: completed estimate points plus a quarter of in-progress points, over all points. 0 when no issue has an estimate.

fields.label: Issues
fields.description: Issues in the cycle at Linear's latest end-of-day count. Empty before the cycle's first day ends.

fields.label: Completed issues
fields.description: Completed issues at Linear's latest end-of-day count.

fields.label: Issues added
fields.description: How many more issues the cycle holds now than at the end of its first day. Issues removed count against it, so it can be negative.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The kind of status, which every workspace shares. The status's own name is Status name.

fields.label: Teams
fields.description: The project's teams, up to its first 25.

fields.label: Progress
fields.description: Linear's progress for the project, as a percentage.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: A project memory applies to its project. A private one applies to you in every project.

fields.label: Written by
fields.description: Who wrote the current version, as the memory file records it. Empty for a file edited by hand.

fields.label: Superseded
fields.description: Another memory replaces this one.

fields.label: Day
fields.description: The start of the UTC day the occurrences fell in.

fields.label: Parent run
fields.description: The run that started this one as a child, or null for a run started on its own.

fields.label: Error
fields.description: The first line of the run's error or cancel reason, at most 200 characters.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: From start to its final status, or null while the run is still going.
